unit: seconds of wall time with GPU 0 occupied (1 GPU); GPU-h = seconds / 3600
basis: captured-p3b replay on the same v0.9.1 image (GPU0, compile cache seeded): attention-only container 14 s wall incl. start-up and a decode-plan prepare of 1.26 s; v0.7.0 MoE-only container 23 s
CPU dry runs in this package: vLLM + model package import about 11 s per image
serving start-up logs give no per-kernel B12x compile time; a cold CuTe compile of one prefill plan is ESTIMATED at 60-150 s (assumption, not measured)

the serving compile caches (<cache>/vllm-v090 for v0.9.x, <cache>/vllm for v0.7.0) are copied into replay-topk/cache/ before the first run; the v0.9.x DeepGEMM cache holds one sm120_fp8_mqa_logits kernel
kernel calls are milliseconds each: R1 = 153 top-k calls (v0.9.1) / 86 (v0.7.0); R2 = about 30 prefill calls per q regime plus index construction

total.note: warm caches: about 0.05 GPU-h; every compile cold: about 0.17 GPU-h; the budget gate reserves the full caps (700 s = 0.194 GPU-h)
